# China Pins Factory

> Wholesale custom lapel pin and metal badge manufacturer in Kunshan, Jiangsu, China. Established 2009. Stamping, die casting, plating, enamel and inspection under one roof. No minimum order quantity, free 12-hour CAD proof, production only, no retail.

China Pins Factory manufactures custom lapel pins, challenge coins, medals, keychains, cufflinks and metal badges in bulk for distributors, promotional agencies, corporate buyers and event suppliers. The factory is ISO 9001:2015 and BSCI certified, runs six workshops on an owned 8,000 sqm floor, and produces around 2.4 million pieces a year.

Contact: sales@chinapinsfactory.com · +86-157-1104-7494 · WhatsApp: https://wa.me/8615711047494
Quotations are itemised and include the full production specification. No unit prices are published on this site, because the correct figure depends on size, line width, colour count, plating, quantity, packaging and tooling.

## Products

- [Custom enamel pins](https://www.chinapinsfactory.com/products/custom-enamel-pins.html): hard enamel, soft enamel, die struck, 3D die cast and offset printed, each with its technical specification.
- [Challenge coins, medals and metal swag](https://www.chinapinsfactory.com/products/custom-metal-swag.html): larger sizes, thicker stock, edge treatments and multi-sided relief.
- [Custom metal badges](https://www.chinapinsfactory.com/products/custom-metal-badges.html): all-metal badges with no enamel and nothing to chip.
- [Samples and prototyping](https://www.chinapinsfactory.com/products/samples.html): what a physical sample proves and what it does not.
- [Request a quotation](https://www.chinapinsfactory.com/products/request-a-quote.html): send artwork, quantity and delivery date for a 12-hour itemised quote.

## Facts worth knowing

- Base metal for enamel work: 0.3 mm brass, 0.3 mm iron, 0.4 mm stainless steel. Die struck uses solid brass, bronze or iron at 1.0 mm to 1.5 mm.
- Colour limits: up to four Pantone references on hard enamel, up to six on soft enamel, full CMYK on offset printed.
- Relief depth: 0.4 mm to 1.2 mm on die struck, multi-level from 1.5 mm on 3D die cast.
- Lead time: 7 to 10 business days standard production, 5 to 7 business days for offset printed.
- Moulds are archived for three years, so a reorder within that window does not pay tooling again.
- Inspection is 100% piece by piece under daylight, and the inspector's name goes on the batch record.
- Production only. Single pieces are sold as samples, not as retail stock.
